description: The chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language-family groupings in the referenced study, shown as a horizontal bar chart. The category axis is the vertical (y) axis, listing language groups from top to bottom as IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque; the categories appear ordered by decreasing bar length. The value axis is the horizontal (x) axis labeled “# tasks,” using a linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 10, spanning approximately 0 to 80. Each category is represented by a single colored bar: IE-Slavic (light blue) extends to about 79 tasks; IE-Romance (dark blue) to about 50; IE-Germanic (light green) to about 46; Uralic (green) to about 20; IE-Baltic (pink) to about 17; IE-other (red) to about 15; IE-Indic (peach) to about 10; Semitic (orange) to about 8; Turkic (lavender) to about 4; and Basque (purple) to about 3. There is no legend shown, no stacking or grouping within bars, and no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond distinct bar colors.
